The run has confirmed that Ledgerline is a Node.js service using Express, backed by PostgreSQL and S3-compatible storage. The export functionality, which involves saved report filters and exporting their matching transactions, is handled in src/export/ with CSV and XLSX writers, coordinated by src/exportUtils.ts. Export requests go through the Express API in src/api/, with scheduled exports managed by src/export/scheduler.ts. The problem with the Export button likely lies in the UI component state management (React components in src/components/) interacting improperly with the backend API export endpoints (src/api/reports.ts). Overall, the issue points to the integration of frontend export button state and backend export processing and scheduling within these modules.
